concepts.title: Point
concepts.definition: A marked spot that pins down one exact position; the spot itself carries no length, width or thickness.
concepts.key_idea: Shown as a dot and labelled with one capital letter -- pure position, no size.
question_patterns: what is a point
how is a point denoted
does a point have length or breadth
identify the point in the figure
How much length does a point occupy?
Draw and label a point P.

solution_steps.action: identify the mark
solution_steps.explain: A tiny dot represents a point which specifies a location.

solution_steps.action: label the point with a capital letter
solution_steps.explain: A point is named using a single capital letter such as P or A for easy reference.

solution_steps.action: confirm the point has no size
solution_steps.explain: A point marks pure position only -- it carries no length, width, or thickness.

concepts.title: Line Segment
concepts.definition: The straight, shortest route joining two given endpoints, with both endpoints belonging to it.
concepts.key_idea: A piece of a line with two definite ends; AB and BA name the very same piece.
question_patterns: what is a line segment
name the line segments in the figure
how many end points does a line segment have
is AB the same as BA for a line segment
How many endpoints does a line segment AB have?
What do we call the shortest route joining two points?

solution_steps.action: identify endpoints
solution_steps.explain: A line segment is bounded by two points, usually labeled with capital letters.

solution_steps.action: name the segment using both endpoints
solution_steps.explain: The segment joining A and B is written as AB or BA -- both names refer to the same segment.

solution_steps.action: confirm it is the shortest straight path between the endpoints
solution_steps.explain: A line segment is the straight, shortest route joining its two endpoints, and both endpoints belong to it.

concepts.title: Line
concepts.definition: Given two points A and B, the straight path drawn through them runs on endlessly either way; we write it as AB with arrowheads at the two ends.
concepts.key_idea: No endpoints at all -- it continues forever either way. Countless distinct ones can share one single point, but exactly one is fixed by two points.
question_patterns: define a line
how many lines can pass through two points
how many lines can pass through a single point
differentiate between a line and a line segment
How many distinct lines can be drawn through two given points?
What do the arrowheads on AB tell us about the drawing?

solution_steps.action: check for arrows
solution_steps.explain: A line is represented with arrows on both ends to show infinite extension.

solution_steps.action: confirm the line has no endpoints
solution_steps.explain: Unlike a line segment, a line continues endlessly in both directions and has no fixed endpoints.

solution_steps.action: verify uniqueness through two points
solution_steps.explain: Exactly one line can be drawn through two given points, while countless lines can pass through a single point.

concepts.title: Ray
concepts.definition: Begin at a fixed end point and travel straight on forever one way -- that path is a ray, and the fixed end is its initial point.
concepts.key_idea: One endpoint plus endless travel a single way; ray OA cannot be rewritten as AO, because the first letter must name the endpoint.
question_patterns: what is a ray
identify the starting point of the ray
can we write ray OA as AO
name the rays in the given diagram
Which letter names the fixed endpoint of ray OA?
Can the ray OA also be written as AO -- why not?

solution_steps.action: identify start point
solution_steps.explain: The first letter in the ray notation (e.g., O in OA) is the fixed starting point.

solution_steps.action: confirm the ray extends endlessly in one direction
solution_steps.explain: A ray has one endpoint but continues forever in the other direction, unlike a line which extends both ways.

solution_steps.action: check that the order of letters cannot be reversed
solution_steps.explain: Ray OA cannot be written as AO because the first letter must always name the fixed endpoint.

concepts.title: Angle
concepts.definition: Two rays launched from one shared endpoint form an angle; that shared endpoint is the vertex, and the two rays are its arms.
concepts.key_idea: Read it as the amount of turning between the two arms about their shared vertex.
question_patterns: what is an angle
name the vertex and arms of the angle
how is an angle denoted
identify the angle in the figure
How many arms does an angle have?
What is the shared endpoint of the two arms called?

solution_steps.action: locate vertex
solution_steps.explain: The vertex is the common starting point of the two rays.

solution_steps.action: identify arms
solution_steps.explain: The two rays forming the angle are its arms.

solution_steps.action: interpret the angle as the amount of turning
solution_steps.explain: The angle measures how much one arm has turned away from the other about the shared vertex.

concepts.title: Straight Angle
concepts.definition: An opening whose two arms point exactly opposite ways, making one half-turn -- 180 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: The arms settle along one straight path: two right-angle openings placed back to back.
question_patterns: what is a straight angle
what is the degree measure of a straight angle
how many right angles make a straight angle
How much is a half-turn opening in degrees?
Calculate how many right angles fit into a straight opening.

solution_steps.action: calculate measure
solution_steps.explain: A straight angle is half of a full rotation (360).

solution_steps.action: confirm the arms point in opposite directions
solution_steps.explain: The two arms of a straight angle lie along one straight path, making a half-turn of 180 degrees.

solution_steps.action: verify it equals two right angles
solution_steps.explain: Since a right angle is 90 degrees, a straight angle holds exactly two right angles back to back.

concepts.title: Right Angle
concepts.definition: Take a half-turn opening and halve it again -- the 90-degree result is what we call a right angle.
concepts.key_idea: The corner of a sheet of paper: exactly 90 degrees, a quarter of a full turn.
question_patterns: what is a right angle
what is the measure of a right angle in degrees
how much of a full turn is a right angle
How much turn does a right angle cover?
Find the opening made when a half-turn is split into two equal parts.

solution_steps.action: calculate measure
solution_steps.explain: A right angle is half of a straight angle (180).

solution_steps.action: confirm it is a quarter of a full turn
solution_steps.explain: A full turn is 360 degrees, so a right angle covers one quarter of it.

solution_steps.action: verify against a familiar reference
solution_steps.explain: The corner of a sheet of paper forms a right angle of exactly 90 degrees, confirming the result.

concepts.title: Angles in a Clock
concepts.definition: Consecutive numerals on a clock face are placed so that turning from one to the next sweeps 30 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: A dozen numerals split the 360-degree dial evenly, so neighbouring numerals span 30 degrees; at hour h the gap from the 12 mark is h x 30.
question_patterns: what is the angle at 1 o'clock
calculate the angle between clock hands at 4 o'clock
find the angle at 6 o'clock
How much is the angle at 3 o'clock?
Calculate the gap between the hands at 8 o'clock.

solution_steps.action: determine unit angle
solution_steps.explain: The total 360 degrees is divided by 12 hours.

solution_steps.action: multiply by hours
solution_steps.explain: Multiply the unit angle by the number of hour divisions.

solution_steps.action: verify the result does not exceed 360 degrees
solution_steps.explain: Since 12 hour marks cover the full 360-degree dial, the angle at any hour h is h*30 and stays within 0 to 360.

concepts.title: Acute Angle
concepts.definition: An opening narrower than 90 degrees but wider than nothing at all.
concepts.key_idea: Sharp and narrow: any opening between 0 and 90 degrees.
question_patterns: define an acute angle
is 45 degrees an acute angle
classify an angle of 75 degrees
Is a 60 degree opening acute -- how much under 90 is it?
Classify an opening of 30 degrees.

solution_steps.action: compare with 90
solution_steps.explain: If the angle is less than 90 degrees, it is acute.

solution_steps.action: confirm the angle is greater than 0
solution_steps.explain: An acute angle must also be wider than 0 degrees, so it lies strictly between 0 and 90.

solution_steps.action: classify the angle based on both bounds
solution_steps.explain: Any opening satisfying 0 < angle < 90 is classified as acute, meaning it is sharper and narrower than a right angle.

concepts.title: Obtuse Angle
concepts.definition: An opening broader than 90 degrees yet short of a half-turn -- between 90 and 180 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: Blunt and wide: any opening just over 90 up to but not including 180 degrees.
question_patterns: define an obtuse angle
is 120 degrees an obtuse angle
classify an angle of 150 degrees
How wide must an opening be to count as obtuse?
Classify an opening of 135 degrees.

solution_steps.action: compare with 90 and 180
solution_steps.explain: If the angle is between 90 and 180 degrees, it is obtuse.

solution_steps.action: confirm the angle is strictly greater than 90
solution_steps.explain: An obtuse angle must be wider than a right angle, so it exceeds 90 degrees.

solution_steps.action: confirm the angle is strictly less than 180
solution_steps.explain: An obtuse angle must be shorter than a half-turn, so it stays under 180 degrees, giving the range 90 < angle < 180.

concepts.title: Reflex Angle
concepts.definition: An opening larger than a half-turn yet short of a full turn -- between 180 and 360 degrees.
concepts.key_idea: The outside of a large opening: more than 180 but under 360 degrees; subtract the inner opening from 360 to obtain it.
question_patterns: what is a reflex angle
is 210 degrees a reflex angle
calculate the reflex angle if the inner angle is 100
What is the reflex partner of an 80 degree opening?
Calculate the reflex opening when the inner one measures 65 degrees.

solution_steps.action: subtract from full turn
solution_steps.explain: A reflex angle can be found by subtracting the inner angle from 360.

solution_steps.action: confirm the result lies between 180 and 360
solution_steps.explain: A valid reflex angle must be greater than a half-turn (180) and less than a full turn (360).

solution_steps.action: verify the reflex and inner angles sum to 360
solution_steps.explain: The reflex opening and the inner opening together make a full turn, so their sum should equal 360 degrees.
